metric_definitions: DECISIONS.md D5: M1 rounds until a clean pass; M2 blocking-grade findings per round; M3 share of findings whose cause is the previous round's fix; M4 spec bytes/lines and growth; M5 tool calls/tokens. Shape follows phase2/S1/baseline-metrics.json.

key_to_provenance.read: taken as written from a report, disposition or log line
key_to_provenance.re-derived: counted, parsed, diffed or computed by the recorder from the files/logs (script in /tmp/rec-flg-r2, not kept in the repo)

counting_rule.findings_total: rows of the report's numbered list of NEW findings (R1: section 8 table of 22; R2/R3: section 3.6 table, ids N1.. ). Citation-check notes (C-ids), prior-finding statuses and the carried non-blocking F16 are NOT in findings_total; they are given separately. This is the baseline's rule (baseline-metrics.json counts the numbered findings and lists overstated citations as 'extra').
counting_rule.severity: the label the report states per finding (CRITICAL / MAJOR / MINOR).
counting_rule.blocking_minor: the report's own 'Blocking' column / text (427 grading: CRITICAL and FR-8/FR-9 blocking, MAJOR blocking only with a concrete wrong outcome, MINOR a note). 'minor' = non-blocking.
counting_rule.critical_plus_major: CRITICAL + MAJOR by severity label (baseline proxy_definition), independent of the blocking grade. Note: in these reports 'blocking' and the proxy differ in R1 only (17 vs 13).

proxy_definition: CRITICAL + MAJOR (as phase2/S1/baseline-metrics.json proxy_definition); blocking/minor counts recorded separately because these reports grade them
